title: Glares
doc: Light glares (coronas, volumetric beams and floor reflections) used by lights, clutter, entities and muzzle flashes.

sections.name: #Glares
sections.doc: List of glares; the game searches the file for this header, so text before it is ignored.

fields.name: $Light Color:
fields.doc: Colour of the screen flash when the glare is looked at.

fields.name: $Corona Bitmap:

children.name: $Cone Angle:
children.doc: Angle of the cone in which the corona is visible (the game halves it).

children.name: $Radius Distance Factor:
children.doc: How the corona size changes with distance.

children.name: $Radius Scale Factor:
children.doc: Corona size multiplier (metres for muzzle flashes).

children.name: $Diminish Distance:
children.doc: Distance at which the corona starts to fade; negative never fades.

fields.doc: Corona image; when present, the corona shape fields follow.

fields.name: $Volumetric Bitmap:
fields.doc: Light beam image; when present, its size fields follow.

fields.name: $Reflection Bitmap:
fields.doc: Image drawn as the glare's reflection in mirrored floors.
